READ-ONLY Confluence research task. Atlassian site: zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net, space key SFCC. You must NEVER create, update, comment on, or delete any Confluence page. Only use `mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page`, `mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page_history`, `mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page_children`, and `mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_search`. Load their schemas first with ToolSearch using query "select:mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page,mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page_history,mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page_children,mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_search".

TASK: find every meeting note, workshop record, or decision log in the SFCC space that touches CHECKOUT, DELIVERY, PAYMENT, CART, GIFT CARDS or BOPIS / collect-in-boutique.

Start with these known pages:
- 342360068 — 04.0 Requirements Workshops (use `confluence_get_page_children` to list ALL its children, then read any child whose title relates to checkout, delivery, payment, cart, gift cards, order management, or returns)
- 258408463 — 2.4 Decision Log
- 449282049 — Design Decision Tracker
- 331218950 — 15-07-2026 Global-e Meeting Notes

Then run these searches to catch anything not under those parents:
- query: `text ~ "checkout" AND (title ~ "workshop" OR title ~ "meeting" OR title ~ "notes" OR title ~ "decision")` (limit 30)
- query: `title ~ "Workshop"` (limit 30)
- query: `title ~ "Meeting Notes"` (limit 30)
- query: `title ~ "Decision"` (limit 25)
If a CQL query errors, retry it as a simple text search instead.

For EACH relevant page report:
1. Exact title and page ID.
2. Last-updated date from `confluence_get_page_history` (most recent version date, author, version number). Say so explicitly if unavailable rather than guessing.
3. Who attended (if recorded) and the date of the meeting itself.
4. Every DECISION recorded that touches checkout / delivery / payment / cart / gift cards / BOPIS — quote VERBATIM, with any decision ID/reference.
5. Every open action or unresolved item on those topics — quote VERBATIM with owner if named.

For the Decision Log (258408463) and Design Decision Tracker (449282049) specifically: list EVERY row that touches checkout, delivery, payment, cart, gift card or BOPIS, quoting the decision text and its status verbatim.

Also flag explicitly:
- Anything you searched for and found NOTHING on.
- Any page that 404s or you cannot access.

Do NOT write any report files. Return your findings directly as your final message. Keep it structured and factual. Do not invent page IDs, dates, or statuses.

Also handles rework from CodeRabbit or reviewer change requests after a PR is open.

Reads the session transcripts and run artefacts for named stories, diagnoses where the loop failed and whose gap it was, checks whether the skills still cite things that are true, and proposes concrete edits to the build skills and loop agents — applied only on Marcel's explicit go.

Gathers and cross-checks every source — Jira, Confluence, the FED handbook, the codebase and Figma — flags every gap and misalignment, then produces an executable closed-loop build plan and hands off to zimmerMANNBuild. Research complete. Findings below. ## Tooling caveat (affects every "last updated" answer) `confluence_get_page_history` on this MCP server returns **only** the page body at a given version plus the version number — it returns **no version date and no version author**. The `created` / `updated` metadata fields come back as empty strings on every `confluence_get_page` call too. **Last-updated dates and authors are therefore unavailable** for every page below; I'm reporting current version numbers instead rather than guessing dates. One useful side-discovery: markdown conversion silently **drops Confluence `` date macros**. The Decision Log's Date column renders blank in markdown but is populated in raw storage format. All dates below came from raw storage (`convert_to_markdown: false`), not from markdown. --- # A. Primary in-scope pages ## 1. `331218950` — 15-07-2026 Global-e Meeting Notes **Version 3.** Meeting date: **15 July 2026 — 11:00 AM**. Title: "Global-e Integration — Kick-off & Requirements Alignment". **Attendees (as recorded):** Timothy Boyd, Luke Holtfreter, Volodymyr Dendevych, Sean Doonan (Global-e); Lucy Fu, Rebecca Jourdan, Emma Kirwan (Zimmermann); Natasha Lay, Charmaine Lew, Manikandan Ramachandran, Hardi Sempuno, Navarro Marcel Angelo N., victor.t.crisostomo (Accenture). This is by far the richest source. **Decisions / confirmations recorded (verbatim):** Checkout architecture: - "design is fully controlled by Zimmermann across all pages **except** the Global-e checkout, which is an iframe." - "The checkout flow is triggered via a **Send Cart hook** that passes basket contents to Global-e. The Global-e checkout renders as a **1-page iframe checkout**, which aligns with current designs." - "Global-e handles: duties & taxes calculation, local payment methods, and the order confirmation screen within the iframe." - "SFCC still creates the order after Global-e checkout completes (OOTB Global-e cartridge behaviour) — order is then forwarded to NewStore." Order flow / fraud: - "**Do not forward to NewStore** until fraud check is passed and order status is updated by Global-e." - "Return status updates are posted by Global-e directly to **NewStore** (not SFCC). Manikandan confirmed this is the desired behaviour — the team will rely on NewStore for return status." **Gift cards — the one explicitly labelled "Decision" on the page:** - "**Decision:** Given timelines, gift cards on Global-e storefronts are deferred. Natasha to confirm this sits on the enhancements backlog." - Context: "Global-e confirmed gift card support **is possible** — requires a section in the Global-e checkout for gift card number and PIN." - "Integration flow: Global-e calls a hook in SFCC → SFCC calls Givex to validate → passes result back to Global-e (with any required format transformation)." - "Emma noted there is an existing limitation between Magento and Global-e for gift cards." Sign-in at checkout (proposed, not decided): - "Global-e checkout **does not currently support sign-in** within the iframe." - "**Proposed approach:** Two versions of the sign-in flow:" / "**International (Global-e):** Sign in first (pre-checkout), then redirect to Global-e checkout with customer context passed through." / "**Domestic:** Single-page checkout with sign-in inline (as designed)." - "Rebecca raised this as an **offline action** to work through with the design team." **Open actions on these topics (verbatim, with owners):** | Task | Owner | |---|---| | "Share order status list and transactional email trigger sequence" | Timothy Boyd (Global-e) — due "TBC" | | "Confirm gift cards deferred to enhancements backlog" | Natasha Lay (Accenture) — "Not in scope for initial go-live" | | "Work through sign-in at checkout flow with design team" | Rebecca Jourdan (Zimmermann) / Design team — "Two versions required: international (pre-checkout sign-in) vs domestic (inline)" | | "Check if Global-e SFCC cartridge supports login" | Timothy Boyd (Global-e) — "To support loyalty/saved cards/customer group use cases at international checkout" | | "Confirm VIC catalogue-based promotion support in SFCC cartridge" | Timothy Boyd (Global-e) — "Historically unsupported in Magento — may work differently in SFCC" | | "Confirm pricing strategy mapping (dynamic vs fixed per country) — lift-and-shift or changes?" | Rebecca Jourdan (Zimmermann) | | "Schedule fulfilment alignment session" | Global-e / Accenture / Zimmermann | All due dates on this page are "TBC". ## 2. `258408463` — 2.4 Decision Log **Version 10.** Five rows total; **three touch the target topics.** Quoted verbatim, dates from raw storage: **DC001** — Date `2026-06-16` — Status **"OPEN"** (Yellow) - Decision: "Real-time stock check scope between cart and checkout" - Options Considered: "Option A: Real-time stock check for all orders between cart and checkout." / "Option B: Real-time stock check for time-sensitive fulfilment only (same-day delivery, potentially express and BOPIS where a date commitment is made)" - Decision Made: **"TBC"** - Rationale: "Option A risks performance impact at checkout.
